text:
Mira: FYI saw a weird spike in structured-output failures and a small perf regression after landing the kernel-selector tweak (commit 9f3a2b6). Failed evals show JSON fields missing and some hallucinated keys.
Alex: ugh. Is this when mixed-quant routing now prefers the int4 fallback earlier? saw that change in the selector PR.
Devon: what do the eval deltas look like? numbers please (accuracy / hallucination rate / P95 latency)
Mira: quick paste from the nightly run:
```
baseline (fp8-only): halluc_rate=0.6%  schema-fail=0.2%  p95=180ms
after selector+mixquant: halluc_rate=2.4%  schema-fail=1.7%  p95=195ms  throughput -6%
```
Sophie: interesting that p95 jumped and throughput dropped. profiler shows extra kernel-switch overhead when batch sizes hit 3-5.
Devon: can you attach the kernel selection trace and KV-cache stats? suspect a cache miss cascade + extra memcpy when switching dtype paths.
Mira: pasted trace:
```
[trace] request_id=zz-123 kernel_choice=autopick -> tried fp8_k1 -> fallback int4_k2 at layer 7 -> recompile=false
[kv] cache_hit=86% cache_stale=12% kv_miss_path=memcpy+quantize
```
Alex: that kv_miss_path stands out. If fallback occurs mid-request we end up re-quantizing KV pages which can change token logits slightly and cause structural drift.
Sophie: agreed. Also calibration step introduced a per-layer min_scale clamp last week; if int4 path clamps differently we can cause distribution shift.
Devon: repro steps?
Mira: small repro in sandbox:
1) run `rdw-run --model prod-mix-1 --quant mix-int4-fp8 --kernel-auto`
2) invoke eval harness dataset X (seed=42)
3) compare `eval.jsonl` outputs
Broken sample printed:
```
{"request_id":"r-78","response":{"items":[],"intent":"unk___generated"}}
```
(should be: {"items":[{"id":...}],"intent":"purchase"})
Alex: can we force the kernel selector to prefer fp8_k1 for the whole request as a quick mitigation?
Sophie: yes, we can add a per-request affinity flag or force `kernel_hint=prefer_fp8`. But that's bandaid.
Devon: short term plan: 1) add gating to disable mid-request kernel switching 2) check kv cache serialization path to avoid quantize+memcpy on fallback 3) run calibration consistency tests across quant mixes
Mira: I'll open a triage PR with failing eval ids + repro job. Also adding metrics to log when a fallback happens mid-request.
ci-bot: started job rdw-ci/quant-triage-1779999999 (queued)
Alex: thanks. if someone can own the fallback de-dupe work i'll pair on the cache side.
Mira: I'll take fallback de-dupe and log instrumentation. Devon, Sophie can tackle kv memcpy and selector heuristics.
Devon: ack. will post a short design sketch in the thread later.
Sophie: adding a note — running a synthetic microbench for batch sizes [1,2,4,8] with forced fallbacks helps reproduce p95 bump.
Mira: nice. keeping thread for updates. :thumbsup:
